# Video script: Rate and rhythm in one minute of scanning

> DRAFT - NOT FOR CLINICAL USE. Contains claims with status 'ai-extracted' that no clinician has verified.

Unit D8 | Target length: 4 min

| # | Shot | Narration | Claims |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Four-chamber clip, normal rhythm, with rate displayed | One-twenty to one-sixty, and regular. Check it on every four-chamber view. | IS23-033 |
| 2 | Clip with an occasional early beat and a pause | A skipped beat now and then is the commonest rhythm finding. It is often harmless and usually settles. | IS23-034 |
| 3 | Graphic: counting beats between pauses | Count the beats between the pauses. More often than every three to five beats, or still irregular after a week or two, and the fetus needs further assessment. | IS23-035 |
| 4 | Split screen: hand pressing then easing / rate slowing then recovering | Slow? Ease the pressure and watch. If it recovers, that is seen in normal fetuses. If it stays at one-ten or below, a specialist needs to see this fetus. | IS23-036 |
| 5 | Clip of a fast regular rhythm with rate displayed | Fast for a moment with movement, up to one-eighty, can be normal. Staying at one-eighty or above cannot be left. | IS23-037 |
